knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(DoE.base)
library(ggcorrplot)
library(plotly)
```

```{r}
test <- fac.design(nlevels = 2, nfactors = 5, replications = 2)
test <- FrF2(nfactors = 5,  resolution = 3, replications = 1)
test <- corrPlot(test)
test <- as.data.frame(test)
#test <- rownames_to_column(test)
test <- pivot_longer(test, cols = !rowname, names_to = "variables", values_to = "correlation")

  tmp <- ggplot(test, aes(x = as.factor(rowname), y = as.factor(variables), fill = correlation)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", lwd = 1, linetype = 1) +
    geom_text(family = "Arial", size = 5, aes(label = correlation, color = after_scale(prismatic::best_contrast(fill, c("white", "black"))))) +
    scale_fill_viridis(option = "C", discrete = FALSE, direction = -1, name = "Correlation") +
    labs(x = "Variables", y = "Variables") +
    # coord_fixed() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 16, family = "Arial", face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 16, family = "Arial"),
      legend.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 16, family = "Arial", face = "bold")
    ) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(family = "Arial", face = "bold", size = 16))
```
